notablePrerequisites:
Seeker of Skybreak and Selvala do not have summoning sickness.
You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {G} and three mana of any color(s).
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Selvala.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Selvala.
Repeat.
